name: RCSB PDB
tagline: Protein Data Bank structures, search, and sequence APIs
description: RCSB Protein Data Bank web services for searching, retrieving, and analyzing macromolecular structure data from the PDB archive, including REST Data API, Search API, GraphQL, and related endpoints.

auth.details: No API key required for public endpoints; open access over HTTPS.

use_cases: fetch PDB entry metadata for a structure ID
download polymer entity or assembly annotations
query structures with GraphQL for nested fields
